Four test files exercise `findEnclosingSgSymbols`. The symbol graph tags it `[untested]`, but that's wrong: these four files import and call it directly.

- `tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts` calls it directly. It also reaches it through the `ast_search` tool (`registerSgTool`) by setting `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG=1`.
- `tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts`
- `tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts`
- `tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts`

The only other caller is `registerSgTool` in `src/sg.ts` (line 415). It calls the function only when `PI_CONTEXT_HYGIENE_DEBUG === "1"` and the match spans no more than a set number of files. Many other sg tests (e.g. `sg-output-consumers`, `sg.format`) register the tool, but none of them set that flag, so they never reach `findEnclosingSgSymbols`. The one exception is `context-hygiene-sg.test.ts`, which is already listed.

To rerun them:
```
npx vitest run tests/context-hygiene-sg.test.ts tests/issue-234-sql-mapper.test.ts tests/json-mapper-root-array-sg.test.ts tests/issue-242-sql-boundary-consumers.test.ts
```
